operative_context: Maintenance duration is dynamic and depends on the specific Equipment Category as defined in the Maintenance Matrix
Upon reaching the rental end date, the system shall update the rent status to 'Maintenance'
All other machinery can stay at the 2-hour (120 minute) maintenance rule
The system shall automatically update availability status when rent lifecycle events occur
Concrete Mixers MUST have a 12-hour (720 minute) maintenance window
After the maintenance period is completed, the status transitions to 'Available'
The system shall mark items as unavailable during maintenance periods
exceptions: Concrete Mixer category has a hardcoded 12-hour (720 minute) maintenance window, overriding the dynamic Maintenance Matrix until the official Matrix is published in the next SRS version
conflicts_or_obsolete: The dynamic Maintenance Matrix referenced in SRS v1.2 is not yet finalized and has been superseded by the emergency hardcoded rule for Concrete Mixers
notes: PRIMARY evidence E1 is an operational override email establishing an emergency hardcoded rule for Concrete Mixers (12-hour maintenance window) that supersedes the dynamic Maintenance Matrix in SRS v1.2. CONTEXT evidence E2, E3 establish the baseline rent completion and maintenance status transition rules. E4 raises an unresolved question about early completion timing. E8, E9 establish availability blocking during maintenance periods. The operative context reflects both the baseline behavior and the category-specific exception for Concrete Mixers. The Maintenance Matrix itself remains a gap since its full definition is not provided in the evidence.
